abstract: In this commentary, we describe how the Clinical Genome Resource's (ClinGen's) application programming interface-based microservices accelerate growth and dissemination of knowledge about human genetic variation. By exposing findable, accessible, interoperable, reusable, and AI-ready variant data, ClinGen lays a foundation for next-generation software applications, AI systems, and variant classification workflows.
